Hymn 236: Lord, Accept into Thy Kingdom
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Alexander Schreiner
Lyricist/Text Author: Mabel Jones Gabbott
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 236 titled "Lord, Accept into Thy Kingdom" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Alexander Schreiner and the lyrics were written by Mabel Jones Gabbott.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
